answer: Edge-Echo Reachability. Each new node must be reachable from three disjoint clusters within one epoch; its vertex enters the graph only after independent paths confirm it. A joining node must also sign a delta of prior interactions, signed by each cluster's relay. Sybil rings stay small and cannot fake disjoint paths, so each accepted identity costs a full relay round trip and a vault of epoch records the attacker must fabricate credibly.
